english.note: Use this when the friendliness emphasizes human warmth and a personal touch rather than simple politeness.
Use this when humanity means human warmth, kindness, or consideration shown to others.
Use 人情味 for warmth shown through kindness, friendliness, or humane feeling toward others.

examples.english: This little shop has a real sense of friendliness.
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 siu2 dim3 hou2 jau5 jan4 cing4 mei6

examples.english: This cha chaan teng has a lot of humanity.
examples.traditional: 呢間茶餐廳好有人情味。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 hou2 jau5 jan4 cing4 mei6

examples.english: The owner of this little shop has so much warmth and always helps customers in need.
examples.traditional: 呢間小店嘅老闆好有人情味，客人有需要一定會幫手。
